en.t: That was the general meaning of the poem.

units.source_text: 他又对亲王说：“这回的事情我办得如此认真，似乎太好事了。

en.t: He then said to the prince, “I seem to have taken this matter so seriously that I may have overdone it.

units.source_text: 但我认为，我只有这一个女儿，办得体面些也是应该的。

en.t: But I feel that since she is my only daughter, it is only right to arrange things with some dignity.

units.source_text: 女儿长得并不端正，未便请疏远的人结腰。

en.t: My daughter is not especially beautiful, so it would be awkward to ask someone distant to perform the waist-cord tying.

units.source_text: 所以我想请秋好皇后乞假回家，担任这个职务。

en.t: So I would like to ask Empress Akikonomu to take leave, come home, and undertake this role.

units.source_text: 秋好皇后同她谊属姐妹，而且彼此熟悉。

en.t: Empress Akikonomu is bound to her as a sister, and they know each other well.

units.source_text: 不过此人气度高雅，仪态万方，叫她来看这个万事都很平常的仪式，委屈了她。”

en.t: However, she is a person of such refined bearing and graceful presence that it would be unfair to ask her to attend a ceremony where everything is so ordinary.”

units.source_text: 萤兵部卿亲王说：“你家这位未来的皇后为欲肖似现在的皇后，当然必须请她来结腰。”

en.t: Prince Hotaru, Minister of War, said, “If this future empress of your house is to resemble the present empress, then of course you must ask her to tie the waist cord.”
